body:
Three real, distinct fixes shipped: (1) spray_place_decal raycast used p->yaw/pitch (stale, only synced at tick points) instead of the live cam_yaw/cam_pitch driving the actual crosshair -- decals landed in a totally random spot. (2) draw_flashlight_beam's cone used a fixed FLASHLIGHT_RANGE ring regardless of nearby geometry, so close to a wall the ring (and connecting triangles) fell behind the surface and depth-tested away entirely -- now clamped to a real forward raycast so the beam shrinks in length near walls instead of vanishing; also widened FLASHLIGHT_HALF_ANGLE_DEG 20->27 for a genuinely bigger illuminated footprint. (3) retro_lighting.c added a real sun/moon sky-fill term (direction-independent scattered light, the same real reason outdoor shaded walls are never pitch black) plus brightened the per-box procedural tint (0.28-0.49 -> 0.62-0.90, a leftover pre-real-texture darkening layer) -- daytime walls no longer compound three multiplicative darkening factors into near-black. All live-verified via Xvfb before/after screenshots. Commits 764a24a, ddf4bc3, 13825e2.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix spray decal aim (stale networked yaw) + flashlight beam close-range clip + realistic daylight
